observed_value: blank interest_rate and basis_spread on flagged PRIVATE_CREDIT rows
anchor_value: raw source shows the sampled flagged blank-rate rows are unfunded revolving or delayed-draw commitments with no stated reference-rate or interest-rate cells

culprit_citations.quoted_text: Albers Aerospace Holdings LLC | 2nd Lien Senior Secured Delayed Draw Loan | $ | 1,983 | $ | ( 30 )
AVSC Holding Corp. | 1st Lien Senior Secured Revolving Loan | 962 | -

findings.detail: X02 is firing on unfunded commitment rows whose raw SOI cells for Reference Rate and Spread and Interest Rate are blank.

rationale: The row-validation issue is not a source/extraction defect for the sampled flagged rows. In the SOI, Albers Aerospace Holdings LLC has blank Reference Rate and Spread and Interest Rate cells while carrying maturity 6/22/2031, par 1,983, amortized cost (30), and fair value (30); the commitments table separately identifies the same issuer and amount as a 2nd Lien Senior Secured Delayed Draw Loan unfunded commitment. AVSC Holding Corp. shows the same pattern: a blank-rate SOI row with par 962 and fair value zero, matched by the commitments table as a 1st Lien Senior Secured Revolving Loan unfunded commitment. The extracted blank rate therefore matches the raw source; the rule is over-scoped when it treats these unfunded commitment rows as missing income-rate data.
